name: Blood Stance
description: Normal melee attacks gain 35% area and 30% attack speed and apply Bleed by default. Choose one stance per run.

name: Iaijutsu Stance
description: Charge a 200 cm-wide spectral lane for 1 second, gently pulling nearby enemies into it. The lane hits instantly after charging and marks enemies for 3 seconds, making them take 50% more damage from subsequent hits. Choose one Samurai stance per run.

name: Blood Transfer
description: On death, spread Bleed stacks to nearby enemies.

name: Bleed Stacks per Hit
description: +1 Bleed stack per hit per rank, up to five ranks.

name: Bleed Duration
description: +1 second Bleed duration per rank, up to three ranks.

name: Attack Speed
format: +{Percent}% Samurai attack speed. Stance multipliers still apply.

name: Overkill Burst
description: Direct Samurai melee and Blade Wave killing blows explode for their excess damage in a 220 cm radius, scaling with Samurai area. A 150-damage hit killing a 40-HP enemy explodes for 110 damage. Assists, Bleed and explosion kills do not trigger explosions.

name: Wave Volley
description: Each committed Samurai swing launches 1 additional Blade Wave per rank, up to 3 additional waves. Requires Blade Wave. Additional waves share normal wave damage, width, returning behavior and scaling. Combines with Crossing Blades.
